title: Merging Client Hints Infrastructure into HTML (and FETCH) Standards

labels.name: topic: fetch
labels.description: Integration with Fetch: CORS settings, referrer policy, fetch priority and lazy loading

body:
Hello [HTML](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/) (and [FETCH](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/)) people, the [Client Hints Infrastructure Draft](https://wicg.github.io/client-hints-infrastructure/) owners want to know if the following work would be welcome:

1. Merging the concepts defined in [Section 3](https://wicg.github.io/client-hints-infrastructure/#environment-settings-object-processing) and the patching defined in [Section 4](https://wicg.github.io/client-hints-infrastructure/#html) into [HTML](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/).
2. Merging the concepts defined in [Section 5](https://wicg.github.io/client-hints-infrastructure/#request-processing) and the patching defined in [Section 6](https://wicg.github.io/client-hints-infrastructure/#fetch) into [FETCH](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/).
3. Keeping the entire [Feature Registry](https://wicg.github.io/client-hints-infrastructure/#registry) in WICG *or* including consensus parts in [HTML](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/) while maintaining the rest in WICG.

I'm able to do the actual heavy lifting in PRs, but wanted to check if there was an issue before starting.

cc: @yoavweiss @miketaylr
